audit.why: 46.81% over 1393 games is the worst row in this slice and TRICKY 7/10 matches it. The reason is mechanical: Doom 'n Gloom fears and interrupts dashes, and Heroic Swing is Akshan's entire escape, so his safety tool is the thing she punishes.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[] gave Vex level 6 and 2+ items while win[] and the packet give both to Akshan, and give her the first-item row instead.
audit.why: Level 6 is Akshan's row because Comeuppance reaches 2500 while Shadow Surge has to travel to him; her spike row is first item.
audit.corrected: All seven sides realigned to win[]; ratings set so Akshan rows read high and Vex rows low, matching the convention in the rest of this champion's charts.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Doom Arrival' is not a Vex ability, and it is used in six fields. Personal Space is separately credited with dash-punishing true damage in another eight.
audit.why: Vex's ultimate is Shadow Surge (140/120/100s, 2000/2500/3000 range): a missile that marks a champion and recasts into a dash. Her fear comes from Doom 'n Gloom, the passive — while empowered, her next basic ability fears and interrupts dashes, and nearby enemy dashes leave a mark that shortens the empower cooldown. Personal Space is W: a 475-range shield with nearby damage on 16s at rank 1. There is no true damage anywhere in her kit. The decisive fact for Akshan is that Doom 'n Gloom interrupts Heroic Swing, which is both his engage and his only exit.
audit.corrected: Every 'Doom Arrival' replaced with Shadow Surge, every dash-punish credited to Doom 'n Gloom, and the true damage claim removed.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns stated, and the tracked ability was the wrong one.
audit.why: Shadow Surge is 140s at rank 1 and Mistral Bolt is 8s falling to 4s at 1200 range; the empower is a rolling passive timer, so the tell is the glow, not a cast.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rewritten around the glow and the 140s ult.

edits.after: - Doom 'n Gloom is the one to read: while she glows, her next ability fears you and interrupts dashes, and Heroic Swing counts as one. - Shadow Surge is 140s at rank 1 and only dashes once its missile marks you, so break line of sight and the recast dies.

edits.before: Shield + AoE fear that punishes dashes — never dash onto her while her passive glows. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: Her empowered ability fears you and interrupts the swing — never swing at a glowing Vex. Until it is spent, every commit is a coin flip.

edits.before: Vex spends Personal Space (Fear) early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Vex spends Doom 'n Gloom on the wave — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.

edits.before: Carry through strings and executes — chip everything, finish anything under a third, and let the swing write angles no one wards.
edits.after: Carry from outside her 1200: never swing at a glowing Vex, chip instead, and let Comeuppance finish what Mistral Bolt started.

edits.before: If Vex takes first blood, tighten up: Personal Space (Fear) is now always up in your head. A second kill means the duel is over and the game isn’t — farm with Q strings and stay relevant through R executes.
edits.after: If Vex takes first blood, stop swinging entirely — Doom 'n Gloom turns your only escape into her kill window. A second kill means the duel is over: farm from 850 and stay relevant through Comeuppance.

edits.before: Ahead, bully harder: string Vex off every contact, swing-roam the rivers, and execute the map's mistakes with R.
edits.after: Ahead, punish the glow gap: trade only while Doom 'n Gloom is dark, and Comeuppance her the moment she is chipped.

edits.before: Vex's ranged poke and passive true damage punish Akshan's melee-range dash engages badly at level 1.
edits.after: Mistral Bolt out-ranges you at 1200 and her empowered passive fears the swing, so level 1 is hers.

edits.before: Personal Space continues to counter your dash-based aggression through level 2.
edits.after: Doom 'n Gloom keeps interrupting every swing-in you try through level 2.

edits.after: Shadow Surge is still a threat, but its 140s cooldown is one you can bait out first.

edits.before: Vex's Personal Space passive punishes any dash you make into her range with bonus true damage, so early E engages just feed her the exact trade she wants — she out-pokes you with Q Mistral Bolt and forces you off the wave.
edits.after: Doom 'n Gloom punishes any dash you make near her — while she glows her next ability fears you and interrupts the swing outright, so early E engages just feed her the trade she wants while Mistral Bolt out-ranges you at 1200.

edits.before: Doom Arrival roots and fears anything dashing or fleeing near her, which directly punishes your E swing-in engage; you have to bait the ult before committing, since eating it mid-swing is a near-guaranteed follow-up kill for her.
edits.after: Shadow Surge marks you from 2000 away and recasts into a dash straight onto you, and with Doom 'n Gloom loaded the fear lands as she arrives; bait the glow before committing, since eating both mid-swing is a near-guaranteed kill for her.

edits.before: Once you have lethality online you can finally punish her lack of a hard escape — if you can walk her down without triggering her passive shield-break bonus damage, your burst catches up to her damage output.
edits.after: Once you have lethality online you can finally punish her lack of a hard escape — walk her down while Doom 'n Gloom is dark, and Personal Space's 16s shield is the only thing left between you and her health bar.

edits.before: Vex wins the lane hard in the first two levels — every time you dash toward her with E, Personal Space triggers bonus true damage that turns your engage into a losing trade, and her Q poke chips you down safely from range. She has no reliable way to punish you if you play patiently and just last-hit, but any aggressive dash gets punished immediately, so you're forced into a passive farming lane through level 5.
edits.after: Vex wins the lane hard in the first two levels — every time you swing toward her while Doom 'n Gloom glows, her next ability fears you and interrupts the swing outright, and her 1200-range Q chips you down safely. She has no reliable way to punish you if you play patiently and just last-hit, but any aggressive swing gets punished immediately, so you're forced into a passive farming lane through level 5.

edits.before: Level 6 flips briefly in her favor since Doom Arrival is a long-range root/fear that catches you mid-engage or mid-retreat, but by the time you're fully leveled at 4-5 you can start weaving in safer Q pokes rather than diving. Respect her ult cooldown and bait it out with W stealth before committing to any all-in.
edits.after: Level 6 stays dangerous since Shadow Surge marks you from 2000 away and recasts into a dash that arrives with the fear, but by the time you're fully leveled at 4-5 you can start weaving in safer Q pokes rather than diving. Respect its 140s cooldown and bait it out with W camouflage before committing to any all-in.

edits.before: Once you hit your first back and pick up lethality, your burst finally outpaces her static damage — the key is engaging from camouflage or a flank angle rather than a straight dash so Personal Space doesn't punish you, letting your all-in land before she can kite back to safety.
edits.after: Once you hit your first back and pick up lethality, your burst finally outpaces her static damage — the key is engaging from camouflage or a flank angle rather than a straight swing so Doom 'n Gloom cannot fear you out of it, letting your all-in land before she kites back.
